entries.en: A raindrop landed on the page and blurred the ink.
entries.zh: 一滴雨落在纸页上，洇开了墨迹。

entries.en: He had the audacity to charge us for his own mistake.
entries.zh: 他竟然厚着脸皮，让我们为他自己的错误付费。

entries.en: The developer planned to bulldoze the abandoned warehouse next month.
entries.zh: 开发商计划下个月用推土机拆平那座废弃仓库。

entries.en: The guide lifted the lid of an empty wooden cask.
entries.zh: 导游掀开了一个空木桶的盖子。

entries.en: We covered the tables with newsprint before opening the paint pots.
entries.zh: 打开颜料罐之前，我们在桌上铺了新闻纸。

entries.en: The little piggy in her picture wore bright yellow boots.
entries.zh: 她画中的小猪穿着鲜黄色的靴子。

entries.en: A songbird perched on the fence outside our kitchen window.
entries.zh: 一只鸣禽停在厨房窗外的栅栏上。

entries.en: Behind the old kitchen, a scullery held two deep sinks.
entries.zh: 旧厨房后面有一间洗涤室，里面装着两个深水槽。

entries.en: The leaflet explained autoimmune conditions in language patients could understand.
entries.zh: 这份宣传单用患者能理解的语言介绍了自身免疫性疾病。

entries.en: The landlord started playing hardball when we questioned the extra charges.
entries.zh: 我们质疑额外收费后，房东开始采取强硬手段。

entries.en: She laughed scornfully at the suggestion that she needed permission.
entries.zh: 听到有人说她需要得到许可，她轻蔑地笑了。

entries.en: I felt like a boob after pulling the door marked PUSH.
entries.zh: 我拉了那扇标着“推”的门，觉得自己像个傻瓜。

entries.en: Their dialectical approach examined how opposing ideas could reshape each other.
entries.zh: 他们采用辩证方法，考察相互对立的观点如何彼此重塑。

entries.en: She offered to repair the fence as atonement for breaking it.
entries.zh: 她提出修好栅栏，以弥补自己弄坏它的过错。

entries.en: An infestation of moths had damaged the stored wool blankets.
entries.zh: 成群的蛀虫损坏了存放的羊毛毯。

entries.en: The lever allows disengagement of the gears before maintenance begins.
entries.zh: 这根操纵杆可在维修开始前解除齿轮的接合。

entries.en: Could I have my sandwich with mustard instead of mayo?
entries.zh: 我的三明治可以用芥末酱代替蛋黄酱吗？

entries.meaningZh: 孩子（苏格兰及英格兰北部用语）
entries.en: Her Scottish grandfather called every bairn in the village by name.
entries.zh: 她那位苏格兰祖父叫得出村里每个孩子的名字。

entries.en: The photographer artfully hid the damaged wall behind a curtain.
entries.zh: 摄影师巧妙地用帘子遮住了受损的墙面。

entries.en: Three empty boxes balanced precariously on the edge of the shelf.
entries.zh: 三个空盒子摇摇欲坠地叠放在架子边缘。

entries.en: She packed a neck pillow for the long intercontinental flight.
entries.zh: 她为这趟漫长的洲际航班带了一个颈枕。

entries.en: A cold breeze touched the nape of his neck.
entries.zh: 一阵冷风吹过他的后颈。

entries.en: New students found the technical nomenclature harder than the basic concepts.
entries.zh: 新生觉得那些专业术语比基本概念更难掌握。

entries.en: The barmaid set two glasses of water beside our drinks.
entries.zh: 酒吧女服务员在我们的饮料旁放了两杯水。

entries.en: The path curved around a craggy ridge above the lake.
entries.zh: 小路绕过湖上方一条岩石嶙峋的山脊。

entries.en: The novel explores how totalitarianism intrudes into ordinary family life.
entries.zh: 这部小说探讨了极权主义如何侵入普通家庭生活。

entries.en: Each searcher carried a map of the missing hiker's route.
entries.zh: 每名搜寻者都带着失踪徒步者所走路线的地图。

entries.en: Fresh white paint brightened the clapboard on the cottage walls.
entries.zh: 新刷的白漆使小屋外墙的搭接板焕然一新。

entries.en: An orange anemone clung to a rock in the tide pool.
entries.zh: 一只橙色海葵附着在潮池里的一块岩石上。

entries.en: We watched a kestrel hovering over the field beside the road.
entries.zh: 我们看着一只红隼在路旁的田野上空悬停。

entries.en: The squeaky hinge announced every visitor before the door opened fully.
entries.zh: 门还没完全打开，吱吱作响的铰链就报出了每位来客。

entries.en: Remove the tough, fibrous stalks before chopping the leaves.
entries.zh: 切叶子之前，先去掉坚韧而多纤维的茎。

entries.en: Interpretative panels helped visitors understand the ruins beneath their feet.
entries.zh: 说明展板帮助游客了解脚下的遗址。

entries.en: We sheltered from the shower beneath the library's stone portico.
entries.zh: 我们在图书馆的石柱门廊下躲避阵雨。

entries.meaningZh: 小型机场（英式，较旧用语）
entries.en: The flying club keeps its oldest aircraft at a rural aerodrome.
entries.zh: 飞行俱乐部把最老的飞机停放在乡间的一座小机场。

entries.en: Movable partitions let us divide the hall into smaller rooms.
entries.zh: 活动隔板让我们能把大厅分成几个小房间。

entries.en: The old catechism presented religious teachings through questions and answers.
entries.zh: 这本旧教理问答以问答形式介绍宗教教义。

entries.en: They grow vegetables on a small croft near the coast.
entries.zh: 他们在海岸附近的一座小农场种菜。

entries.en: He added chopped kale to the soup just before serving.
entries.zh: 他在上汤之前加入了切碎的羽衣甘蓝。

entries.en: A scrawny kitten followed us home from the bus stop.
entries.zh: 一只瘦骨嶙峋的小猫从公交站一路跟着我们回家。

entries.en: The climbing roses soon covered the trellis beside the gate.
entries.zh: 攀缘玫瑰很快爬满了门边的棚架。

entries.en: She asked rhetorically whether anyone enjoyed waiting in the rain.
entries.zh: 她反问道，难道有人喜欢在雨中等候吗？

entries.en: My latte went cold while I searched for the missing receipt.
entries.zh: 我找那张不见的收据时，拿铁咖啡已经凉了。

entries.en: In the American cartoon, the cowboy landed flat on his fanny.
entries.zh: 在那部美国动画片里，牛仔摔了个屁股着地。

entries.en: Although classically trained, the pianist loved improvising with jazz musicians.
entries.zh: 这位钢琴家虽受过古典音乐训练，却很喜欢和爵士乐手即兴演奏。

entries.en: The plotter produced a detailed floor plan on a large sheet.
entries.zh: 绘图仪在一张大纸上输出了详细的平面图。

entries.en: The novel's laird refuses to sell any part of his estate.
entries.zh: 小说中的苏格兰庄园主拒绝出售庄园的任何一部分。

entries.en: The family arranged a small memorial gathering after the cremation.
entries.zh: 家人在火葬之后安排了一场小型追思会。

entries.en: Her essay offers a vivid evocation of childhood summers by the river.
entries.zh: 她的文章生动地唤起了童年在河边度过夏日的情景。

entries.en: An individualist at heart, he rarely followed the latest fashion.
entries.zh: 他骨子里是个特立独行的人，很少追随最新潮流。

entries.en: Please check the capitalization of names before printing the invitations.
entries.zh: 印请柬之前，请检查姓名的大小写。

entries.en: She pulled a folded timetable from her battered leather satchel.
entries.zh: 她从破旧的皮挎包里拿出一张折好的时刻表。

entries.en: Our hamster dragged a strip of paper into its little house.
entries.zh: 我们的仓鼠把一条纸拖进了它的小窝。

entries.en: The documentary follows an amputee as she trains for a cycling race.
entries.zh: 这部纪录片记录了一位截肢女性为自行车赛训练的过程。

entries.en: The diagram overleaf shows where each shelf bracket should go.
entries.zh: 本页背面的示意图标明了每个搁板支架应安装的位置。

entries.en: A faded blue bedspread covered the bed in the guest room.
entries.zh: 客房的床上盖着一条褪色的蓝床罩。

entries.en: The historian traced the dynastic rivalries behind the disputed marriage.
entries.zh: 历史学家追溯了那桩有争议的婚姻背后的王朝纷争。

entries.en: We brought the towels off the clothesline before the rain started.
entries.zh: 下雨之前，我们把毛巾从晾衣绳上收了下来。

entries.en: The brochure listed concessionary fares alongside the regular ticket prices.
entries.zh: 手册在普通票价旁列出了优惠票价。

entries.en: He mistook her sensible refusal to climb for simple cowardice.
entries.zh: 他把她明智地拒绝攀爬误认为单纯的胆怯。

entries.en: The strangeness of the empty house made every small noise noticeable.
entries.zh: 这座空房子的陌生感让每一点细小的声响都格外明显。

entries.en: A red paper streamer hung from the ceiling above the cake.
entries.zh: 蛋糕上方的天花板上挂着一条红色纸彩带。

entries.en: The deer stalker moved slowly, keeping downwind of the herd.
entries.zh: 那名猎鹿者慢慢移动，始终保持在鹿群的下风处。

entries.en: She spoke candidly about the difficulties of running a small shop.
entries.zh: 她坦率地谈到了经营一家小店的难处。

entries.en: As a materialist, he sought physical explanations for conscious experience.
entries.zh: 作为唯物主义者，他试图从物质层面解释意识体验。

entries.en: It took me weeks to understand the team's technical lingo.
entries.zh: 我花了几个星期才听懂团队里的技术行话。

entries.en: Mix the powder with water until it forms a smooth slurry.
entries.zh: 将粉末与水混合，直到形成均匀的浆液。

entries.en: She filled a warm pita with roasted vegetables and hummus.
entries.zh: 她往热皮塔饼里夹了烤蔬菜和鹰嘴豆泥。

entries.en: The groom slipped a soft halter over the pony's head.
entries.zh: 马夫把柔软的笼头套在小马头上。

entries.en: The seminar examined arguments about the constitutionality of the proposed law.
entries.zh: 研讨课讨论了有关拟议法律合宪性的论点。

entries.en: He finished his schoolwork before joining us in the garden.
entries.zh: 他做完功课后，来到花园里与我们会合。

entries.en: We packed the toddler's potty beside the bag of spare clothes.
entries.zh: 我们把幼儿便盆放在备用衣物袋旁一起装好。

entries.en: The distiller described how she selected barrels for the new spirit.
entries.zh: 这位酿酒师介绍了她如何为新酒挑选酒桶。

entries.en: She asked the agent how many years remained on the leasehold flat.
entries.zh: 她询问中介，这套租赁产权公寓的租期还剩多少年。

entries.en: A flotilla of kayaks gathered near the mouth of the river.
entries.zh: 一队皮划艇聚集在河口附近。

entries.en: The chair's legs splay outward to give it a wider base.
entries.zh: 椅腿向外张开，使底部支撑更宽。

entries.en: The councilman asked residents where a new crossing was needed.
entries.zh: 那位市议员询问居民哪里需要增设人行横道。

entries.en: Choose a typeface that remains clear when the label is small.
entries.zh: 请选择一种在标签较小时仍然清晰的字体。

entries.en: The inspector rejected the substandard bricks before construction began.
entries.zh: 施工开始前，检查员剔除了那些不达标的砖。

entries.en: He took a sneaky look at the birthday presents behind the sofa.
entries.zh: 他偷偷瞄了一眼沙发后面的生日礼物。

entries.en: Her brief flirtation with pottery ended when the local studio closed.
entries.zh: 当地工作室关闭后，她对陶艺的短暂尝试也结束了。

entries.en: The play questions whether kingship depends on birth or public trust.
entries.zh: 这出戏探讨君王身份究竟取决于出身还是民众信任。

entries.en: She wrote about the support she received after her mastectomy.
entries.zh: 她写下了自己接受乳房切除术后得到的支持。

entries.en: The town's chronicler preserved accounts of floods, weddings and local disputes.
entries.zh: 镇上的历史记录者保存了洪灾、婚礼和地方纠纷的记载。

entries.en: The suffix in happiness turns the adjective into a noun.
entries.zh: happiness 中的后缀把形容词变成了名词。

entries.en: Her gentle modulation kept the long reading from sounding monotonous.
entries.zh: 她柔和的语调变化使长篇朗读不显单调。

entries.en: The exhibition includes letters written during the family's wartime internment.
entries.zh: 展览中有这家人在战时被拘禁期间写的信。

entries.en: The librarian placed the heavy folio on a padded book support.
entries.zh: 图书管理员把沉重的对开本放在有软垫的书托上。

entries.en: The boatman helped us board without getting our bags wet.
entries.zh: 船夫帮助我们登船，没有弄湿我们的包。

entries.meaningZh: 阿亚图拉（什叶派宗教学者尊称）
entries.en: The journalist requested an interview with a senior ayatollah.
entries.zh: 记者请求采访一位资深阿亚图拉。

entries.en: He sliced the salami thinly and arranged it around the cheese.
entries.zh: 他把萨拉米香肠切成薄片，摆在奶酪周围。

entries.en: She moved her rook across the board to defend the king.
entries.zh: 她把车移到棋盘另一侧，保护国王。

entries.en: A loose strap let one snowshoe slip off his boot.
entries.zh: 一根松脱的绑带使一只雪地行走板从他的靴子上滑落。

entries.en: The museum invited a tanner to demonstrate traditional leather preparation.
entries.zh: 博物馆邀请了一位制革工匠演示传统皮革加工。

entries.en: The club condemned the hooliganism that had disrupted the match.
entries.zh: 俱乐部谴责了扰乱比赛的流氓滋事行为。

entries.en: A qualified volunteer agreed to officiate at the junior tournament.
entries.zh: 一位有资质的志愿者答应为青少年锦标赛担任裁判。

entries.en: He seemed uninterested in the film until the final scene.
entries.zh: 直到最后一幕，他似乎一直对这部电影不感兴趣。

entries.en: Her programmatic speech outlined the party's priorities for the coming year.
entries.zh: 她的纲领性演讲概述了该党未来一年的重点工作。

entries.en: The brass knocker was shaped like a fox holding a ring.
entries.zh: 黄铜门环做成了一只衔着圆环的狐狸。

entries.en: The philosopher offered a materialistic account of thought and perception.
entries.zh: 这位哲学家对思维和知觉提出了唯物主义的解释。

entries.en: She surreptitiously checked her phone beneath the conference table.
entries.zh: 她在会议桌下偷偷看了一眼手机。

entries.en: The menu offered grilled halibut with lemon and roasted potatoes.
entries.zh: 菜单上有配柠檬和烤土豆的烤大比目鱼。

entries.en: An archivist helped us locate the original plans for the bridge.
entries.zh: 一位档案管理员帮助我们找到了这座桥的原始设计图。

entries.en: He stopped to unbutton his coat before entering the warm kitchen.
entries.zh: 进温暖的厨房前，他停下来解开了外套纽扣。

entries.en: She leaned two large cushions against the wooden headboard.
entries.zh: 她把两个大靠垫靠在木床头板上。

entries.en: The waiter smiled apologetically and brought us a clean tablecloth.
entries.zh: 服务员带着歉意笑了笑，给我们拿来一块干净桌布。

entries.en: The timer records each runner's finish to the nearest millisecond.
entries.zh: 计时器记录每位跑者的完赛时间，精确到毫秒。

entries.en: He eyed the narrow doorway doubtfully, then measured the sofa again.
entries.zh: 他疑虑地看了看狭窄的门口，又量了一遍沙发。

entries.en: She waved dismissively when I suggested checking the figures again.
entries.zh: 我建议重新核对数字时，她不屑地挥了挥手。

entries.en: A tailback stretched from the tunnel entrance to the next junction.
entries.zh: 堵塞的车流从隧道入口一直排到下一个路口。

entries.en: The notice warned that prohibited items were subject to confiscation.
entries.zh: 告示警告说，违禁物品将被没收。

entries.en: Cut the loaf crosswise into slices of equal thickness.
entries.zh: 把面包横着切成厚度相同的片。

entries.en: We watched wildfowl settle on the marsh through the hide's window.
entries.zh: 我们透过观鸟屋的窗口，看野生水禽落在沼泽里。

entries.en: The class debated whether determinism leaves any room for free will.
entries.zh: 全班辩论了决定论是否还给自由意志留有空间。

entries.en: Her grandparents kept photographs from their naturalization ceremony in an album.
entries.zh: 她的祖父母在相册里保存着入籍仪式的照片。

entries.meaningZh: 墨西哥裔美国人（尤指男性）
entries.en: A young Chicano in the novel struggles to reconnect with his grandparents.
entries.zh: 小说中一位年轻的墨西哥裔美国男子努力重新亲近祖父母。

entries.en: The report compared nationalization with several other approaches to railway reform.
entries.zh: 这份报告比较了国有化与另外几种铁路改革方式。

entries.en: The lecturer pointed to the uterine wall on the anatomy diagram.
entries.zh: 讲师指着解剖图上的子宫壁。

entries.en: The old register recorded whether each child was born in wedlock.
entries.zh: 旧登记簿记载了每个孩子是否为婚生。

entries.en: Electrification of the railway required new cables along the entire route.
entries.zh: 铁路电气化需要沿全线铺设新的电缆。

entries.en: We booked the Saturday matinee so the children could come too.
entries.zh: 我们订了星期六的日场，这样孩子们也能一起来。

entries.en: A physiologist explained the experiment's purpose before the volunteers began cycling.
entries.zh: 志愿者开始骑行前，一位生理学家解释了实验的目的。

entries.en: Building repairs fall outside the ambit of this particular committee.
entries.zh: 建筑维修不属于这个委员会的职责范围。

entries.en: Tourists stopped to gawk at the enormous sculpture blocking the square.
entries.zh: 游客们停下来，目瞪口呆地看着占据广场的巨型雕塑。

entries.en: The newscaster paused while a technician adjusted her microphone.
entries.zh: 技术人员调整话筒时，新闻播音员暂停了播报。

entries.en: A kink in the hose stopped water reaching the flower beds.
entries.zh: 水管上的一个弯折挡住了流向花坛的水。

entries.en: He apologized profusely after spilling coffee across her carefully drawn map.
entries.zh: 把咖啡洒在她精心绘制的地图上后，他再三道歉。

entries.meaningZh: 小伙子（称呼语，有时显得居高临下）
entries.en: "Listen, sonny, this machine is older than you," the mechanic joked.
entries.zh: “听着，小伙子，这台机器比你还老，”修理工开玩笑说。

entries.en: She secured her snowboard to the roof rack before we left.
entries.zh: 出发前，她把单板滑雪板固定在车顶架上。

entries.en: The lantern's warm radiance reached the far corners of the room.
entries.zh: 灯笼温暖的光辉照到了房间最远的角落。

entries.en: They rented the top floor of a brownstone on a quiet street.
entries.zh: 他们租下了一条安静街道上一栋褐砂石住宅的顶层。

entries.en: Extra padding around each glass reduced breakage during the move.
entries.zh: 每个玻璃杯周围多加的衬垫减少了搬运中的破损。

entries.en: The drawing showed a swordfish beside a much smaller fishing boat.
entries.zh: 画上是一条剑鱼，旁边的渔船显得小得多。

entries.en: She used a ladle to fill each bowl with hot soup.
entries.zh: 她用长柄汤勺给每只碗盛上热汤。

entries.en: The shop displayed its wool knitwear away from direct sunlight.
entries.zh: 商店把羊毛针织服装陈列在阳光不会直射的地方。

entries.en: An octagonal window cast an unusual patch of light on the floor.
entries.zh: 一扇八边形窗在地板上投下形状独特的光斑。

entries.en: The peach had soft, velvety skin and a deep golden color.
entries.zh: 这个桃子的果皮柔软如绒，呈深金黄色。

entries.en: His letter expressed repentance without asking her to forgive him immediately.
entries.zh: 他的信表达了悔意，却没有要求她立即原谅。

entries.en: A pink peony bent beneath the weight of the morning rain.
entries.zh: 一朵粉色芍药被清晨的雨水压弯了。

entries.en: He grinned sheepishly when we discovered the missing biscuits in his bag.
entries.zh: 我们在他的包里找到不见的饼干时，他不好意思地咧嘴笑了。

entries.en: A mallard paddled beneath the bridge while we unpacked our lunch.
entries.zh: 我们拿出午餐时，一只绿头鸭从桥下游过。

entries.en: The magician's cloak promised invisibility, but his shoes remained clearly visible.
entries.zh: 魔术师的斗篷号称能使人隐形，他的鞋子却依然清晰可见。

entries.en: The documentary challenges the claims made by a white supremacist.
entries.zh: 这部纪录片质疑了一位白人至上主义者提出的主张。

entries.en: The dog sat obediently beside the gate while its owner unloaded groceries.
entries.zh: 主人卸下采购的食品时，狗乖乖坐在门旁。

entries.en: Wearing an old hat, the actor passed unrecognized through the crowd.
entries.zh: 演员戴着一顶旧帽子走过人群，没有被认出来。

entries.en: The deliberate mutilation of the manuscript left several pages impossible to read.
entries.zh: 手稿遭到蓄意毁损，导致其中几页无法辨读。

entries.en: The chapter examines land ownership and military obligations under feudalism.
entries.zh: 这一章考察了封建制度下的土地所有权和军事义务。

entries.en: A firecracker went off nearby, startling everyone waiting at the corner.
entries.zh: 附近一声爆竹响，把等在街角的人都吓了一跳。

entries.en: The fictional couple disagreed about the terms of spousal support.
entries.zh: 那对虚构夫妻对配偶赡养费的条款有分歧。

entries.en: A long-legged wader searched for food at the water's edge.
entries.zh: 一只长腿涉禽在水边觅食。

entries.en: The letter remained undiscovered inside the desk until the house was sold.
entries.zh: 那封信一直藏在书桌里，无人发现，直到房子被卖掉。

entries.en: The riverboat stopped at three small towns before reaching the city.
entries.zh: 这艘内河船在抵达城市前停靠了三个小镇。

entries.en: The researcher warned against treating poverty itself as evidence of criminality.
entries.zh: 研究者提醒，不应把贫穷本身视为犯罪行为的证据。

entries.en: A visiting jurist discussed competing interpretations of the old legal text.
entries.zh: 一位来访法学家讨论了对那份古老法律文本的不同解读。

entries.en: Her restlessness grew as the train sat motionless outside the station.
entries.zh: 火车停在站外一动不动，她越来越坐立不安。

entries.en: The pathfinder marked a safe route through the fallen branches.
entries.zh: 探路者在倒下的树枝间标出了一条安全路线。

entries.en: The sermon opened with a scriptural passage familiar to the congregation.
entries.zh: 讲道以一段会众熟悉的圣经经文开场。

entries.en: The editor removed the unsupported accusation after concerns about defamation arose.
entries.zh: 有人提出诽谤方面的担忧后，编辑删去了那项缺乏依据的指控。

entries.en: The elastic waistband made the trousers comfortable during the long journey.
entries.zh: 松紧裤腰使这条裤子在长途旅行中穿着舒适。

entries.en: I daresay the missing keys will turn up when we stop looking.
entries.zh: 我想，等我们不找了，那串不见的钥匙就会出现。

entries.en: The article discussed age restrictions on the sale of hardcore pornography.
entries.zh: 文章讨论了销售露骨色情制品的年龄限制。

entries.en: The astronomy exhibit included a photograph of the Sun's corona.
entries.zh: 天文展览中有一张太阳日冕的照片。

entries.en: She remained unyielding in her demand for an independent inspection.
entries.zh: 她坚持要求独立检查，毫不让步。

entries.en: A shared joke finally eased the awkwardness between the two former colleagues.
entries.zh: 一个彼此都懂的笑话终于缓和了两位昔日同事之间的尴尬。

entries.en: His cheerful summary seemed to trivialize the difficulties the volunteers faced.
entries.zh: 他轻快的总结似乎淡化了志愿者面对的困难。

entries.en: We followed the towpath past moored boats and an old lock.
entries.zh: 我们沿着纤道走，经过停泊的船只和一座旧船闸。

entries.en: The lab assistant checked the label on the peroxide container.
entries.zh: 实验室助理检查了过氧化物容器上的标签。

entries.en: At the curator's behest, we moved the fragile vase indoors.
entries.zh: 应策展人的要求，我们把易碎的花瓶搬到了室内。

entries.meaningZh: 社会化；学习社会交往的过程
entries.en: The nursery encourages socialisation through shared games and group storytelling.
entries.zh: 托儿所通过集体游戏和小组讲故事鼓励孩子学习社会交往。

entries.en: An empathetic listener lets people explain their worries without interrupting.
entries.zh: 善解人意的倾听者会让人说完自己的烦恼，而不打断。

entries.en: The actor wore a tight corset beneath her elaborate stage costume.
entries.zh: 那位演员在华丽的戏服里面穿着一件紧身胸衣。

entries.en: The team tested a more aerodynamic helmet in the wind tunnel.
entries.zh: 团队在风洞中测试了一款更符合空气动力学的头盔。

entries.en: The novel follows a serf who dreams of leaving the estate.
entries.zh: 小说讲述了一个梦想离开庄园的农奴的故事。

entries.en: The village planted an oak to memorialize its much-loved schoolteacher.
entries.zh: 村民种下一棵橡树，纪念那位深受爱戴的教师。

entries.en: The historian examined letters written before his appointment to the bishopric.
entries.zh: 历史学家研究了他获任主教之前写的信。

entries.en: "Wonderful timing," he said sarcastically as the rain soaked our picnic.
entries.zh: “时机真好，”雨水淋湿野餐食物时，他挖苦地说。

entries.en: A local celeb volunteered to judge the children's baking competition.
entries.zh: 一位当地名人自愿为儿童烘焙比赛担任评委。

entries.en: The futurist painted speeding trains with bold lines and fractured shapes.
entries.zh: 这位未来主义画家用粗犷的线条和破碎的形状描绘疾驰的列车。

entries.meaningZh: 教堂祭坛附近供神职人员和唱诗班使用的区域
entries.en: The choir assembled in the chancel before the evening service.
entries.zh: 晚间礼拜前，唱诗班在教堂的圣坛区集合。

entries.en: A cicada called from the tree above our garden bench.
entries.zh: 一只蝉在花园长椅上方的树上鸣叫。

entries.en: The aquarium's largest tank housed a sturgeon longer than the guide.
entries.zh: 水族馆最大的水箱里养着一条比导游身高还长的鲟鱼。

entries.en: Her friends arranged lifts to the hospital during her chemo.
entries.zh: 她做化疗期间，朋友们安排接送她去医院。

entries.en: An untitled sketch hung between two large portraits near the entrance.
entries.zh: 入口附近，两幅大型肖像画之间挂着一张无题素描。

entries.en: The film follows a samurai returning to his village after years away.
entries.zh: 影片讲述了一名日本武士离乡多年后返回村庄的故事。

entries.en: The student drew the shell and soft body of the mollusc.
entries.zh: 学生画出了这只软体动物的外壳和柔软身体。

entries.en: The nurse asked about his previous experiences of anaesthesia.
entries.zh: 护士询问了他以前接受麻醉的经历。

entries.en: Her grandmother remembered seeing singers and jugglers in vaudeville shows.
entries.zh: 她祖母记得曾在杂耍歌舞演出中看过歌手和杂耍艺人。

entries.en: "Blimey, that suitcase weighs more than you do!" he exclaimed.
entries.zh: “天哪，那个行李箱比你还重！”他惊呼道。

entries.en: A tern flew low over the harbor as we approached the pier.
entries.zh: 我们走近码头时，一只燕鸥低低地飞过港口。

entries.en: The safety briefing focused on preventing the inhalation of fine dust.
entries.zh: 安全说明重点介绍了如何防止吸入细小粉尘。

entries.en: The sameness of the hotel rooms made each trip blur into the next.
entries.zh: 千篇一律的酒店客房让每次旅行都变得难以区分。

entries.en: The cheap rehearsal rooms became a hotbed of experimental music.
entries.zh: 这些廉价排练室成了实验音乐的温床。

entries.en: Their aunt acted as peacemaker when the argument threatened to spoil dinner.
entries.zh: 争论眼看就要破坏晚餐气氛时，他们的姑妈出面调解。

entries.en: The café earned the moniker Little Jungle because of its many plants.
entries.zh: 那家咖啡馆因绿植众多而得了“小丛林”的绰号。
